personal_details.name: Shaik Mohammed Bilal
personal_details.title: AI & Data Science Engineer
personal_details.points_to_user:
Based on the modifications made to align with the Deloitte AI and Data Science Engineer II role, you should focus on strengthening your knowledge in the following areas for technical interviews:
1.  **Core Data Science & Machine Learning**: Deepen your understanding of Classification, Regression, Time Series forecasting, Decision Trees, and Optimization algorithms. Be prepared to discuss model selection, evaluation metrics (Precision, Recall, F1-Score, RMSE, MAE), and hyperparameter tuning.
2.  **Python Data Science Stack**: Ensure you are highly proficient with the specific libraries mentioned in the JD: NumPy, Pandas, and Scikit-learn. Practice data manipulation, feature engineering, and building end-to-end ML pipelines using these tools.
3.  **Cloud & Big Data Platforms**: Familiarize yourself with Databricks, Snowflake, and at least one major hyperscaler (AWS SageMaker, Azure ML, or GCP Vertex AI). Understand the concepts of model deployment and serving on these platforms.
4.  **Model Deployment & MLOps**: Study Docker containerization for packaging models and Git for version control. Be ready to discuss CI/CD pipelines for ML, model monitoring, and A/B testing.
5.  **End-to-End Project Delivery**: Practice articulating your experience in delivering large-scale DS/ML projects from inception to implementation, covering requirements gathering, data engineering, modeling, deployment, and stakeholder collaboration.
6.  **Statistics & Mathematics**: Brush up on core statistical concepts (distributions, hypothesis testing) and linear algebra fundamentals that underpin ML algorithms.
7.  **Data Visualization**: While not heavily emphasized in your resume, be prepared to discuss your experience with or knowledge of Tableau or PowerBI for creating dashboards and presenting insights.
